authority.purpose: complete Unicode/grammar proof contract for Owner decision and later corrected Design

grammarSelection.rule: exactly one registry tuple may be selected by the Owner and referenced by hash in a corrected Design; zero, multiple, missing or hash-mismatched selections fail closed

resultDomain.allow: no registered grammar or structural failure

acceptedValues: dense readonly array of accepted values
plain own-enumerable-string-key object with Object.prototype or null prototype and accepted values
inputDomain.byteIngress: when bytes exist, decode with fatal UTF-8 before this profile; JavaScript string input is checked for Unicode scalar validity before normalization

values.regexCaseBehavior: registry flags under the exact ECMAScript runtime tuple
values.persistedRule: return paths/categories only; original string/code points and later UTF-8 bytes remain unchanged

keys.exactProjection: NFKC, then ASCII-case-insensitive removal of every code point outside [a-z0-9_]

unicodeRuntime.propertyTruthSource: ECMAScript RegExp Unicode property escapes under this exact tuple
unicodeRuntime.mismatchBehavior: fail closed before profile verification, classifier initialization, architecture gate or build; no runtime fallback table

invalidControlSet.carriageReturn: U+000D is invalid_control even though White_Space matches it
invalidControlSet.precedence: after structural preflight and before grammar/insertion matching

controlAndInsertionPolicy.admittedInsertionSet: the Unicode 17.0 property union minus invalidControlSet

gapSemantics.eligible: only between consecutive consuming atom transitions on one successful closed-AST path
forbidden: between a zero-width assertion and an atom
inside historical key projection beyond projection equivalence

validation: reject extra/missing rule fields, duplicate rule IDs/priorities, invalid flags/domains/kinds/categories
reject unknown/malformed AST nodes, invalid character classes/repetitions/lookarounds
reject missing, recursive, multiply-defined or unused references
require priorities to be the exact contiguous range 1..ruleCount
require every structuredRecognizerId to appear on exactly one structured rule
lowering: inline validated references and expand literal strings to Unicode scalar atoms
lower once to canonical transition IR carrying rule category, priority and target domain
direct recognizer is the IR with inserted-transition budget 0
insertion-aware recognizer is the same IR with declared per-gap and total counters
structured rules use the same IR; structuredRecognizerId is audit metadata, not a second matcher
overflow recognizer from the same IR returns unsupported_value for a complete skeleton exceeding declared counters
grammarCompiler.collision: evaluate applicable rules in ascending global priority; the first match wins

phase1StructuralPreflight: walk the complete value without invoking getters
validate accepted input domain, Unicode scalars, cycles/repeated identity and exact limits
compute raw and NFKC-normalized UTF-8 byte totals
traversal.phase2Classification: depth-first preorder; arrays ascending index; objects Object.keys order; classify each key before its value; within one key/string invalid_control precedes grammar; first traversal path wins
traversal.pathEncoding: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer with ~ and / escaped; root is empty string
traversal.noPartialAllow: any structural failure discovered in preflight overrides an otherwise earlier protected match

limits.applicationLimitsStillApplyFirst: accepted Design V1.4 Section 13.6 remains stricter for explicit/context payloads

consumers.contextScanner: Section 13.6 uses the one selected compiled classifier tuple
consumers.outputA07: A-07 calls the same selected compiled classifier tuple; it may add only A-07's separately enumerated non-protected-data syntax checks
consumers.agreementProof: both consumers expose the same registryId/version/hash and classifier identity; a second instance/profile/hash mismatch fails closed
consumers.noSemanticClaim: the classifier proves only the exact grammar/control result, not privacy classification, factual entailment or malicious intent

futureProviderModelClosure.exactRule: every later approved Provider literal and model-family prefix must be covered as provider_override by the selected registry before adapter/configuration activation
futureProviderModelClosure.missingCoverage: configuration and architecture verification fail closed
futureProviderModelClosure.requiredGate: new reviewed profile plus Owner-approved corrected Design/Phase authorization
